name: tradeagent-proposal
description: Private, opt-in, local Strategy Studio research draft proposal submission; pending metadata only, never approval or saving.

interface.shortDescription: Submit an unapproved draft proposal to your local TradeAgent review ledger.
interface.longDescription: Separate token-gated local proposal MCP only. Creates pending research-draft name and source-hash metadata; requires independent offline operator approval and commit. Cannot save code, backtest, use a broker or trade. No cloud tunnel.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a new Strategy Studio research draft proposal for my explicit review. Never claim a strategy has been saved, backtested or traded.
